adjudication.rationale: In packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts, bookingCalendarReference was changed from a single `.find(...)` to an array `.filter(...)` and then iterated (`for (const reference of bookingCalendarReference)`). Inside the recurring-event branch, for each such reference with `credentialId`, it still runs a sweep over *all* calendar credentials (`bookingToDelete.user.credentials.filter(...).map(...)`) and for each updated booking deletes only `updBooking.references.find((ref) => ref.type.includes("_calendar"))` (the first calendar reference). This means the sweep is executed once per reference (likely per host), and each sweep targets only the first calendar reference of each updated booking—causing repeated deletes of the same host’s events and skipping other hosts’ calendar references.
